description: This file defines the 'NoteView' React component, responsible for displaying a note's details, including title, content, and optional summary, with functionality to fetch and summarize notes via API calls.

methods.name: fetchNote
methods.description: Fetches a note by ID using the API, updates state with note data or handles errors.

methods.name: onSummarize
methods.description: Calls API to generate a summary for the note, updates summary text or handles errors.
